name: twin_per_band
caption: F6 twin contrast per turnover band in three spaces. scope=all is the pooled twins; family scopes are waterloo and reactor. Δ = D_twin_matched − D_control.
alt_text: F6 twin contrast per turnover band in three spaces. scope=all is the pooled twins; family scopes are waterloo and reactor. Δ = D_twin_matched − D_control.
limitations: Divergent iff last-band CI excludes 0 from above; else collapsed. That rule is an NHST default, not an equivalence test. A last-band CI that includes 0 is not occupancy of one lock. Waterloo point Δ need not be 0; reactor never excluded 0 in S5.
